items.action: Record / pause / resume; play / pause while editing
Stop the take and edit it
Confirm discarding the clip and start over
Mirror the preview, or stop (the recording is never mirrored)
Quit (asks first if the take is still recording or unsaved)
Move the playhead 1 second (Shift: 5 s, Alt: 0.2 s)
Jump to the previous / next pause or clip edge
Split the clip at the playhead
Remove the clip under the playhead; in a gap, restore it
Move the start of the clip under the playhead to the playhead
Move the end of the clip under the playhead to the playhead
Zoom to the clip under the playhead; again to zoom out
